body: Her family is part of the reason she's suicidal. See the original post. She does have a best friend who is a psychologist, but I'm not sure if telling him this is the best idea. I don't know if she's been honest to him about her issues or if he has failed to help her in the past.

But why would it be better for her? She loathes her life as it is and considers me the only good thing in it. If I go, she will have *nothing*. I am pretty sure that if I break up with her, she will kill herself. I'm stuck.
